cards.name: form_valid
cards.spec: form_valid(self, form) creates the sale by calling create_sale(customer, number, date), imported from sales.services, with form.cleaned_data customer, number and date. create_sale already saves the Sale, so NEVER call super().form_valid or form.save(). create_sale raises ValueError only when the customer is not active: then call form.add_error(None, str(e)) and return self.form_invalid(form) (status 200, no Sale created). On success return redirect('sales:list'). No messages framework.
